gaps.question: Reconcile the historical RYA-1035 decision-text claim of a 2019 Fe II 3D NLTE leg with the primary release description of 3D LTE table4.
gaps.next_gate: Review the proposed source-text correction; keep the atlas table4 record 3D LTE and do not promote any product.

gaps.question: Which molecular diagnostics have compatible thermochemistry, rates, broadening, isotopic normalization and independent stellar validation?
gaps.next_gate: Release-specific primary-source and applicability review; LTE line lists do not close molecular NLTE completeness.

gaps.question: Which physically characterized reference star and diagnostics can validate the cool-star extension?
gaps.next_gate: Independent benchmark-star selection and verified parameters; this atlas does not adopt a star.

gaps.question: Which exact line/multiplet and stellar/abundance nodes are supported without interpolation or chemistry/atmosphere mismatch?
gaps.next_gate: Review exact nodes, component versus multiplet identity and full hull; broad envelopes are insufficient.

gaps.question: What are the exact version, upstream reuse terms, collision/broadening and thermochemistry provenance for each pending resource?
gaps.next_gate: Primary release and license audit plus component-specific completeness review before reuse or adoption.
